item.title: Prime Video Is Officially Reinventing the Most Iconic Wizard in Fantasy History
item.description: For two seasons of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power , Gandalf (Daniel Weyman) didn't even know he was Gandalf. The mysterious Stranger spent years wandering Middle-earth, struggling to understand his magical powers and whatever cosmic forces brought him there. But after being crowned “ Grand Elf ” at the end of season 2, Gandalf is finally ready to face the real challenge he was meant for.

item.title: Epic Officially Makes Free D&D Game Even Free-er This Week
item.description: This week, the Epic Games Store is offering DLC for an idle Dungeons & Dragons game as well as a great PC game to Epic users for free. For a limited time, you can grab new characters for Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms and a cozy base-building game at no charge.

item.title: 'Zelda: Ocarina of Time' Fans Devastated by Weeklong Shipping Delays
item.description: Nintendo’s remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time releases today, and its first reviews are glowing , with critics calling it a near-flawless recreation of one of the best games ever made . Along with modernizing the classic game's controls and visuals, the remake fixes one of the most hated video game levels of all time: the Water Temple . Unfortunately, all that praise is probably just rubbing salt in the wound for many who pre-ordered the physical version on Amazon.

item.title: 5 Gripping Detective Books That Are Page-Turners From Start to Finish
item.description: Everyone loves a great detective book. These stories satisfy our natural curiosity for solvable mysteries, allowing us to slip into the shoes of competent detectives like Sherlock Holmes , Hercule Poirot , and Benoit Blanc . There’s a sense of satisfaction to following a trail of clues, identifying red herrings, and theorizing before the answers are revealed. Good detective stories use grounded settings to heighten anxiety and embrace some amount of chaos before bringing about a neat resolution.

item.title: Where to find the Tokyo House in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The Tokyo House is a player home located in Tokyo City in Forza Horizon 6 . Each home in Forza Horizon 6 provides you with benefits, and the Tokyo House has one of the best overall. Unfortunately, the Tokyo House is also the most expensive house, unless you have a VIP membership, which makes the house free.

item.title: Summer Tokyo City region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The summer Tokyo City region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 7, "City Life." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

item.title: All active Escape From Tarkov codes and rewards
item.description: Escape From Tarkov promo codes are used in the classic extraction shooter for all sorts of rewards. From in-game gear and weapons to currency, cosmetics, and more, redeeming as many of these Tarkov codes as you can will set you up for your next raid. Especially since these goodies don't actually require a successful extraction to obtain them.

item.title: Andy Weir's New Sci-Fi Epic is ‘The Martian’ Meets ‘The Twilight Zone’
item.description: Andy Weir is known for his dramatic sci-fi survival stories The Martian and Project Hail Mary , which were both adapted into blockbuster films. His latest project combines the same focus on action and ingenuity, but with a more surreal concept that feels straight out of The Twilight Zone . Weir is executive producing Exoplanet , a full-cast audio experience written by Benjamin Percy for Audible. It follows the crew of the starship Wild Blue Yonder as they are scattered across time, landing on the same planet in different eras. The thriller releases on Nov. 5, and Audible provided Polygon with an exclusive clip following Science Officer Logan Bowers (John Leguizamo of The Odyssey ) as he wakes up injured and desperately tries to find help.

item.title: How to unlock the true ending in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero 's true ending is called "Final Battle". You can experience four different endings, but this is only one that will connect all the dots, allowing you to gain a better understanding of the story. You will need to complete a list of side quests before reaching the last boss fight if you want to see what the developers consider the perfect ending to Soul's journey.
